from common import *
import numpy as np
import random

# concepts:
# filtering, single-pixel objects, replication, reference shape

# description:
# In the input, you will see a grid with several single-pixel objects scattered throughout. 
# One of these objects will be part of a reference shape.
# Filter out single-pixel objects that are not part of this specified reference shape.
# Each filtered single-pixel object serves as a pivot point for replicating the reference shape.
# Place a copy of the reference shape centered on each filtered single-pixel object.

def main(input_grid):
    # Detect all single-pixel objects
    single_pixel_objects = detect_objects(
        grid=input_grid, 
        predicate=lambda obj: np.count_nonzero(obj != Color.BLACK) == 1, 
        monochromatic=True, 
        connectivity=4
    )

    # Extract the reference shape (more than one pixel, not a single pixel object)
    reference_shape = detect_objects(
        grid=input_grid, 
        predicate=lambda obj: np.count_nonzero(obj != Color.BLACK) > 1,
        monochromatic=True,
        connectivity=4
    )[0]

    # Convert reference shape to a sprite
    reference_sprite = crop(reference_shape)

    # Prepare the output grid
    output_grid = np.full(input_grid.shape, Color.BLACK)

    # For each single-pixel object, replicate the reference shape centered on that pixel
    for single_pixel in single_pixel_objects:
        # Get the position of the single pixel
        y, x = np.argwhere(single_pixel != Color.BLACK)[0]
        
        # Compute the top-left corner for placing the reference shape
        top_left_x = x - reference_sprite.shape[1] // 2
        top_left_y = y - reference_sprite.shape[0] // 2
        
        # Place the reference shape in the output grid
        blit_sprite(output_grid, reference_sprite, top_left_x, top_left_y, background=Color.BLACK)
    
    return output_grid

def generate_input():
    # Create a grid
    n, m = np.random.randint(10, 15), np.random.randint(10, 15)
    grid = np.full((n, m), Color.BLACK)

    # Choose a color for the single pixel objects and the reference shape
    available_colors = list(Color.NOT_BLACK)
    single_pixel_color = random.choice(available_colors)
    available_colors.remove(single_pixel_color)
    reference_color = random.choice(available_colors)

    # Create and place a reference shape
    ref_shape_width, ref_shape_height = np.random.randint(3, 5), np.random.randint(3, 5)
    reference_shape = random_sprite(
        n=ref_shape_height, 
        m=ref_shape_width, 
        color_palette=[reference_color],
        density=0.5
    )
    x, y = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, reference_shape, padding=1)
    blit_sprite(grid, reference_shape, x, y)

    # Place several single-pixel objects
    num_single_pixels = np.random.randint(3, 6)
    for _ in range(num_single_pixels):
        # Single pixel as a 1x1 sprite
        single_pixel_sprite = np.array([[single_pixel_color]])
        x, y = random_free_location_for_sprite(grid, single_pixel_sprite, padding=1)
        blit_sprite(grid, single_pixel_sprite, x, y)

    return grid
